profile.headline: Unity Developer (Gaming / VR / AR / MR)
profile.summary:
I'm a game developer programming gameplay in C# with Unity 3D. While I was studying I decided to specialize my self into VR and AR projects, but I also write code for PC and mobile games.
Which I most enjoy about game development is the team-working environment, because we all compliment ourselves together and also we can learn new skills from each others.
